// Stands in for "dart pub global activate dart_mutant" in the tests of
// `test_gates mutation`, so that they do not go to pub.dev. Kept as .txt so
// that it is not analyzed or formatted with the package; the tests copy it
// into a temporary directory and run it there, in the package.
//
// It appends the directory PUB_CACHE names to "fetch.log" and, like the
// real command, leaves the compiled program below it:
// global_packages/dart_mutant/bin/dart_mutant.dart-<SDK>.snapshot. That
// "program" is the stand-in for the tool (fake_dart_mutant.dart).
//
// What it does is read from "fake.json" in the current directory (every key
// is optional):
//
//   "fetchExit": 69        it prints "fetchOutput" and ends with this exit
//                          code, without leaving anything
//   "fetchOutput": "..."   what it prints
//   "fetchNothing": true   it ends with exit code 0 and leaves no program
//   "fetched": { ... }     what "fake.json" holds after it ran: what the
//                          tool that was fetched does
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

void main() {
  final file = File('fake.json');
  final fake = file.existsSync()
      ? jsonDecode(file.readAsStringSync()) as Map<String, Object?>
      : const <String, Object?>{};
  final cache = Platform.environment['PUB_CACHE'];
  File('fetch.log').writeAsStringSync('$cache\n', mode: FileMode.append);
  stdout.write(fake['fetchOutput'] ?? '');
  final code = fake['fetchExit'] as int?;
  if (code != null) {
    exitCode = code;
    return;
  }
  if (fake['fetchNothing'] == true) {
    return;
  }
  final bin = Directory('$cache/global_packages/dart_mutant/bin')
    ..createSync(recursive: true);
  File('${bin.path}/README.md').writeAsStringSync('not the program');
  File('fake_dart_mutant.dart')
      .copySync('${bin.path}/dart_mutant.dart-3.0.0.snapshot');
  final after = fake['fetched'];
  if (after != null) {
    file.writeAsStringSync(jsonEncode(after));
  }
}
